what: glass skin for a MetaHuman face: low even roughness, slightly raised specular, shallow pores; the colour stays Creator's synthesised skin (docs/METAHUMAN_LOOKS.md §2)

files.T_GlassSkin_Roughness.png: grey, linear (sRGB off), compression Grayscale: the roughness channel
files.T_GlassSkin_Cavity.png: grey, linear: MetaHuman Creator > Materials > Skin > Texture Override > Cavity (face)
files.T_GlassSkin_SRMF.png: RGBA, linear, compression Masks: channels R=Specular, G=Roughness, B=Metallic, A=Fuzz; swap in for T_Head_SRMF after assembly (verify the order on the first run)
files.T_GlassSkin_NormalMicro.png: RGB, Normalmap, DirectX green: optional; only as the face normal override if the synthesised normal shows pores (it also removes every wrinkle)

creator.skin.face_texture_index: the smoothest (youngest) of the texture types
creator.skin.accents: none, or redness on the cheeks only at 0.1 to 0.2

makeup.foundation.color: the skin tone, half a step lighter

creator.eyes: iris dark brown, limbal ring on, sclera brightness up a little

material_after_assembly.note: the head material instance's global scalars; names vary by version, storykit.skin prints the ones it finds
